governing: The user requires a clean comparison grounded in Projector artifacts before coding, followed by a monitored repeat of the real Steady Helm trial. Approved-plan amendment 9 preserves capabilities, native orchestration, cost-adjusted cadence, and source/installed/behavioral evidence distinctions. The new request authorizes a deterministic transition guard. It does not authorize a second scheduler, production scope reduction, or unrelated installation repair.
cleanCandidate: Start with two explicit phases: assess the intended outcome and connected design, then implement the chosen boundary. The phase transition consumes an inspectable comparison and the architecture review required by native rules. A native pre-tool hook rejects ordinary coding calls before that transition. Assessment work can read sources, run bounded probes and write its account. Keep semantic judgment with the agent and independent reviewer; the hook checks lifecycle and evidence presence only.
comparison: The existing context hook and cadence cache deliver the interrupt correctly but only count declared phases. The failed trial read the procedure, selected the existing design, and wrote production files via Python before any adequate comparison. Completion accepted a path without reading its contents. Required concerns: activation and nested repository boundaries, cheap ordinary work, read-only handoff, compaction costs, legitimate probes, native review and delegation. Replaceable mechanisms: completion based only on a path, reminder-only transition, and ambiguous assessment closure. Keep the existing cadence rather than inventing scheduling. A patch-only gate misses the observed shell write. A shell parser cannot prove arbitrary programs read-only; use an explicit assessment-only declaration and treat mislabeling as behavioral failure.
decision: Replace the transition contract and add one native pre-tool guard. Compared with wording alone, this adds a small schema and guard but makes accidental pre-comparison execution fail immediately. Compared with a sandbox controller, it avoids a second orchestration layer and platform-specific launch machinery. Total cost includes runtime, hooks, affected instructions, existing lifecycle tests and focused guard checks, refresh, and one real supervised rerun. The guard is a cooperative workflow boundary, not a security boundary.
boundary: One runtime owns assessment state and comparison identity. Completion reads a saved comparison account and binds its bytes. SessionStart retains cadence; PreToolUse reads that same state. Guard native shell, patch and delegation entry points. Allow clearly declared assessment shell/probe work and task-record patches; other execution requires a current completed account. Existing unbound candidates require reassessment. Preserve inactive roots, nested repositories, unsaved handoffs and duplicate-transition behavior. Update the procedure, guide, consumer instructions and interface docs together. Native review assesses substance. A fresh Windows session exercises the installed copy before any ordinary production edit in the repeat trial.
validation: Use deterministic lifecycle and hook replays for rejection before execution, completion from a real account, account changes, assessment-only work, inactive roots, and cadence/read-only recovery. Independently review the connected change. In the real trial, inspect the account and its order relative to the first production edit; stop a mislabeled mutation or empty comparison. Compare with the preserved failed trial, report scope and cost differences, and require a real consumer milestone before claiming product completion. A successful hook or field check alone cannot establish useful reasoning.
review: Independent design review by comparison_boundary_review accepted this scoped cooperative boundary before implementation. Final acceptance requires actual host denial before shell/patch/delegation execution, missing/changed/legacy account checks, and the real trial's reasoning and chronology. Official hook input uses the parent session_id for subagents; the guard will use that payload rather than child process environment. Semantic compliance and unhooked or mislabeled operations remain explicit limits.
